title.narrative: Pacific Country Flexible Finance - Climate investment Capacity Support

description.narrative: Capacity support and capability building interventions in 15 Pacific countries. Specifically, in disciplines related to Public Financial Management and Public Investment Management for Climate-related priorities. For example, public financial management systems, support to strengthen national planning, sectoral planning, investment planning, investment proposals, and supplementation of specialist skills (e.g. procurement, monitoring, and reporting) to address capacity constraints.
